feature: Designed for dairy goat farms, by a dairy goat farmer.
description: DigiGoat is built from the ground up to meet the unique needs of dairy goat farms, with features tailored specifically for managing and showcasing your herd.

subFeatures.description: Seamlessly import and sync your herd data directly from the American Dairy Goat Association (ADGA) database, ensuring your website always reflects the most up-to-date information about your goats.
Easily import milk test results from the Council on Dairy Cattle Breeding (CDCB) to provide comprehensive profiles for each of your goats.
Automatically calculates due dates based on breeding dates, helping you manage your herd's kidding schedule effectively.
Each goat in your herd gets its own dedicated page, complete with photos, lineage, and performance data.
All goat pages follow a consistent layout designed specifically for dairy goats, ensuring a professional and uniform appearance across your site.

description: DigiGoat is optimized for farms with limited internet connectivity (or at shows), ensuring smooth operation even with intermittent access.

subFeatures.description: DigiGoat is designed to work offline. This means that the only times you need internet access are when you first download the app, when you publish changes to your website, and when you sync with ADGA/CDCB. This means that when you're at shows and want to add show wins in before you forget, you can do it offline and publish later when you have internet access.
Live Preview works offline as well, so you can see what your website will look like even when you don't have internet access.

DigiGoat websites are built to be lightweight and fast-loading, even on slower connections. This ensures that visitors to your site have a smooth experience regardless of their internet speed. What's even better is the websites are designed to keep the assets in-memory, so once you pull up your website you can keep using it through internet interruptions. Images are also optimized to load on a need-to-see basis, so loading times are kept to a minimum.

description: DigiGoat websites are built with search engine optimization (SEO) best practices in mind, helping your farm rank higher in search results and attract more visitors.

subFeatures.description: DigiGoat automatically generates SEO-friendly metadata for your website and individual goat pages, improving your visibility on search engines. This means you don't have to worry about what data to try to cram into search results, DigiGoat does it for you.

DigiGoat websites support IndexNow, a protocol that allows search engines to be notified of content changes on your site in real-time. This helps ensure that your latest updates are quickly reflected in search results.

DigiGoat websites include Open Graph metadata, which enhances the appearance of your links when shared on social media platforms. This can help increase engagement and drive more traffic to your site.

description: DigiGoat is committed to putting users first, with a focus on delivering a product that is east to use and just makes sense. This means taking input from people you can actually relate to when making changes.

subFeatures.description: DigiGoat offers personalized support from a real dairy goat farmer who understands your needs. This means you can get help and advice from someone who truly gets it, rather than a generic support team.
DigiGoat's development is driven by feedback from its user community, ensuring that new features and improvements are aligned with the needs of dairy goat farmers.
DigiGoat websites automatically receive improvements and optimizations over time, ensuring that your site stays up-to-date with the latest best practices without any extra effort on your part.

DigiGoat is committed to providing a clean and focused user experience, free from ads or upsells that can detract from the core functionality of the product. The only advertising you will see is the non-intrusive This Site Was Created and Is Maintained Using DigiGoat snippet in the footer of your site.

description: Websites shouldn't take a professional web developer to design and maintain. DigiGoat is built to be as simple as possible while still providing powerful features.

subFeatures.description: Easily create and format content using Markdown, a simple and intuitive markup language that allows you to focus on writing without getting bogged down in complex formatting options.
DigiGoat provides intelligent recommendations based on your herd data, helping you quickly fill out simple information like goat names, your farm name, and more.

description: DigiGoat websites support integration with popular analytics platforms, allowing you to track visitor behavior and gain insights into your website's performance.

subFeatures.description: Your website will automatically be enrolled in Google Analytics support, allowing you to track visitor behavior and gain insights into your website's performance.
DigiGoat websites also use Microsoft Clarity, a free analytics tool that provides heatmaps and session recordings to help you understand how visitors interact with your site.

DigiGoat websites are automatically set up with Google Search Console, allowing you to monitor your site's presence in Google search results and optimize your SEO strategy. DigiGoat also automatically submits sitemaps and keeps track of any issues with your website.

DigiGoat websites are also set up with Bing Webmaster Tools, allowing you to monitor your site's presence in Bing search results and optimize your SEO strategy. DigiGoat automatically submits sitemaps and keeps track of any issues with your website.

description: DigiGoat comes with a custom domain and comes with options for custom email addresses and email forwards.

subFeatures.description: Every DigiGoat website comes with a custom domain of your choice (e.g., www.yourfarmname.com) included in your subscription.
DigiGoat offers the option to set up a custom email address via iCloud Custom Email (e.g. digi@yourfarmname.com).
DigiGoat also offers email forwards, allowing you to create multiple email aliases that forward to your existing email account (e.g., digi@yourfarmname.com --> yourname@gmail.com).

description: DigiGoat offers transparent and competitive pricing, with a focus on delivering value to dairy goat farmers.

subFeatures.description: DigiGoat offers a simple all-inclusive pricing model, with no hidden fees or upsells. This means you get access to all features and updates for a single annual fee.
